description:
The Flintstones #9 (May 2017), DC Comics Hanna-Barbera - Variant Cover B by Rob Guillory (Fred reading the Bedrock job listings). Written by Mark Russell, art by Steve Pugh, colors by Chris Chuckry. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Justice League Dark animated movie ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
